description: Dependency updates for tinyzoo. CONTRIBUTING.md ('Dependency updates') says how to handle the pull requests.

packageRules.description: An npm release waits three days before it is proposed: time for a broken or hijacked release to be pulled.
Patch updates: one pull request a week, together with the minor ones below.
Minor updates from 1.0 on join the weekly group. Below 1.0 a minor update may break (drizzle-orm 0.44 to 0.45), so it gets its own pull request, like a major one.

The editor stack moves as one: pnpm-workspace.yaml pins a single copy of @tiptap/core, @tiptap/pm and ProseMirror (two copies break collaborative editing), and Renovate updates those overrides in the same pull request.
Postgres 16 is the server tinyzoo is tested against (CI, the backup check, compose.yaml). Moving to a newer one is a decision, not an update.
